searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: What to search for on Google Maps, e.g. "dentist" or "coffee shop". Each term is run as a separate search (combined with the location below, if set).

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional location appended to every search term, e.g. "Austin, TX" or "Berlin, Germany". Leave empty if your search terms already include a location.

minReviews.title: Minimum number of reviews
minReviews.description: Only include listings with at least this many reviews. Set to 0 to disable.

maxReviews.title: Maximum number of reviews
maxReviews.description: Only include listings with at most this many reviews. Leave empty to disable. Useful for finding smaller businesses.

minRating.title: Minimum star rating
minRating.description: Only include listings rated at least this many stars (0–5), e.g. "4" or "3.5". Leave empty to disable. Listings with no rating yet are excluded when this is set.

maxRating.title: Maximum star rating
maxRating.description: Only include listings rated at most this many stars (0–5). Leave empty to disable. Useful for finding poorly rated businesses.

websiteFilter.title: Website filter
websiteFilter.description: Filter listings by whether they have a website. "Only without a website" is handy for lead generation.

maxResultsPerSearch.title: Max results per search term
maxResultsPerSearch.description: Maximum number of listings to collect per search term (before filtering). Google Maps itself rarely returns more than ~120 results per search.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code for Google Maps (hl parameter). Keep "en" unless you need localized results.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy to use for scraping. Apify residential proxies are strongly recommended — Google blocks datacenter IPs quickly.
